_meta.line: 東京メトロ有楽町線 (Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line)
_meta.direction: 和光市方面 (for Wakoshi / Kawagoe-shi, via Ikebukuro and Kotake-Mukaihara)
_meta.note_direction_order: 池袋 (Ikebukuro) is reached BEFORE 小竹向原 (Kotake-Mukaihara) in this direction, so arr_ikebukuro < arr_kotake for every train.

departures_source.weekday: Ekispert (駅すぱあと for web, roote.ekispert.net/timetable/train/22520/3340), current as of 2026-11-25; cross-checked hour by hour against Ekitan (ekitan.com, diagram revision 2026-03-14) - identical.
departures_source.saturday: NAVITIME depArrTimeList Ichigaya -> Ikebukuro, date=2026-11-28 (Sat), all trains 05:00-24:21.
departures_source.holiday: NAVITIME depArrTimeList Ichigaya -> Ikebukuro, date=2026-11-29 (Sun); verified identical to the Saturday list entry by entry, so saturday and holiday share one list.

_meta.official_page_note: The official Tokyo Metro station timetable page (tokyometro.jp/station/timetable.html) could not be extracted with a text fetch: without train parameters it returns only the station-search shell (JS-rendered), and the per-train URL returned HTTP 403. Departures were therefore taken from Ekispert and NAVITIME pages that republish the official diagram. First train 05:00 and last train 24:21 (00:21) for all three day types match NAVITIME's station FAQ.
_meta.running_time_verification: NAVITIME depArrTimeList checked on 2026-11-25 (Wed). Ichigaya -> Ikebukuro: 12:02 dep -> 12:13 arr = 11 min; 11 min for all daytime trains, 12-13 min on weekday evening-peak trains, 11-12 min on weekends. Ichigaya -> Kotake-Mukaihara: 18 min for Wakoshi/Kotetsu-bound and 19 min for Kawagoe-shi/Hoya-bound daytime trains (e.g. 12:02 -> 12:20, 12:20 -> 12:39), 20-22 min in the evening peak. Fixed values adopted for all trains: Ikebukuro +11 min, Kotake-Mukaihara +19 min.
_meta.arrival_accuracy: arr_kotake / arr_ikebukuro are computed as dep + fixed minutes, not per-train scheduled arrivals. Expected deviation vs the real scheduled arrival: Ikebukuro 0 min daytime, up to +2 min later than shown in the weekday evening peak; Kotake-Mukaihara within 1 min daytime (1 min late for Wakoshi-bound trains), up to ~3 min later than shown in the evening peak.
_meta.dest_source: Per-train destinations (行先) from NAVITIME depArrTimeList Ichigaya -> Edogawabashi (every Wakoshi-direction train stops at Edogawabashi, the first stop, so every departure appears with its destination), dates 2026-11-26 (Thu = weekday), 2026-11-28 (Sat), 2026-11-29 (Sun = holiday), fetched 2026-11-25. Cross-checked against the NAVITIME Ichigaya -> Wakoshi list: for every train that reaches Wakoshi (dest 和光市/志木/川越市/森林公園) the two lists agree. Same current diagram as the departure data (Ekitan revision 2026-03-14). Saturday and holiday destination lists were read in full and are identical train by train, matching the identical departure lists.
_meta.dest_notes: NAVITIME prints 森林公園（埼玉県）; normalized here to 森林公園. dest is appended after the existing fields; dep/arr_kotake/arr_ikebukuro are unchanged. Note: for dest=池袋 trains (a few morning-peak and the last two trains of the day) arr_kotake remains the computed dep+19 value even though the train terminates at Ikebukuro and never reaches Kotake-Mukaihara - use dest, not arr_kotake, to judge through service.
_meta.seibu_through_definition: A train is a Seibu through service (直通) iff its dest is a Seibu Ikebukuro Line station beyond Kotake-Mukaihara: 石神井公園, 保谷, 清瀬, 所沢, 小手指, 飯能. Such trains pass Kotake-Mukaihara without a change and stop at 保谷 (except 石神井公園-bound trains, which terminate one stop before 保谷 but still run through Kotake-Mukaihara onto the Seibu line). dest=和光市 terminates inside the Metro line; dest=志木/川越市/森林公園 are Tobu Tojo Line through services via Wakoshi; all three require a change at Kotake-Mukaihara (or Ikebukuro) for 保谷. dest=池袋 terminates at Ikebukuro, before Kotake-Mukaihara.
